mapper.select: SELECT UR.USER_ID, UR.ROLE_ID, UR.REG_USER_ID, UR.REG_DT FROM TB_COM_USER_ROLE UR INNER JOIN TB_COM_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COM_USER_ROLE (USER_ID, ROLE_ID, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{regUserId}, SYSDATE)
